workaround_steps: Enable Developer Mode inside Windows Subsystem for Android Settings.
Ensure ADB loopback is active on 127.0.0.1:58526.
Start Shizuku service via loopback ADB command: adb shell sh /sdcard/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api/start.sh, or grant root permission directly via Magisk.
known_issues: Requires manual ADB service invocation on boot unless root permission is granted via Magisk.
